summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#674](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/674)**: ALLEGRO_o1_v04 now includes ALLEGRO_o1_v03's `DectDimensions.xml` and the other shared compact files, and keeps only its own HCAL files. This shrinks the silicon wrapper from two layers to one (`SiWr_nLayers` 2 → 1). Samples simulated with the earlier two-layer geometry no longer reconstruct against the new geometry: `DDPlanarDigi` reports "no surface found" errors, so affected inputs must be re-simulated.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#534](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/534)**: Adds `MutableSimCalorimeterHit::addMCParticleContribution`, which attaches a `CaloHitContribution` and adds its energy to the hit in one call. This prevents hit energy from drifting out of sync with its contributions when hits are merged, for example in `OverlayTiming`. New documentation describes `SimCalorimeterHit` as a container of contributions whose energy is their sum, with no time selection applied, so time windows must be handled in digitisation. The data layout is unchanged and there is no schema bump.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1695](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1695)**: Fixes crashes and duplicate container IDs in concurrent DDDigi container combining. Each event now gets its own workers and bookkeeping, and the merge counters are atomic. Some protected members and functions were removed from `DigiContainerCombine.h`, which may affect code that derives from it.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#51](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/51)**: `DDPandoraPFANewAlgorithm` gains theta–energy (2D) EM and hadronic energy corrections. They are read from JSON calibration tables via the `ElectromagneticThetaEnergyCorrectionFile` and `HadronicThetaEnergyCorrectionFile` properties, and validated with LCContent's `ThetaEnergyTable::IsValid`. Existing configurations are unchanged (identity by default). k4GaudiPandora now depends on nlohmann json.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1707](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1707)**: Adds a plugin that builds a DD4hep detector structure from pure geometry setups. A new `examples/DDG3` example, based on ALEPH, shows how to import geometries from legacy Geant3 simulation programs. DDCond and DDCAD gain documentation.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#127](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/127)**: Fixes outside-in CKF (`PropagateBackward`), which previously dropped the outer seed hits from the final track; it now starts at the outermost seed space point. Seed parameters, including the field evaluation, are now estimated at the start space point, which also affects default inside-out seeding. Backward tracks are reversed to inside-out order and stop at the reference surface.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#75](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/75)**: Fixes a crash in `GaudiTrkUtils` (ConformalTracking) for trackers with detector ID > 20. This affects the ALLEGRO and IDEA silicon wrappers, which broke the ILC-era LCIO assumption.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#114](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/114)**: `TracksFromGenParticles` now matches MC particles to tracker hits in a single pass instead of a nested particles × hits scan. This gives roughly an 80× speedup, measured in ALLEGRO ZH digi-reco.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#74](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/74)**: `DDPlanarDigi` now stores the per-layer time resolution as the tracker-hit time error, a field added in EDM4hep 1.2. The error stays 0 without time smearing, and the change is guarded so k4Reco still builds against older EDM4hep.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1706](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1706)**: Fixes volume divisions so that DD4hep volume and placement extensions are assigned when a volume is divided and placed. Previously this led to null-pointer exceptions when traversing the volume hierarchy.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1700](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1700)**: Geant4 actions (event, generator, run, stacking, stepping, tracking) are now looked up by their already-split name. Previously, actions whose names contain the `/` delimiter could not be found (fixes #1693).

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#291](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/291)**: `TopoCaloNoisyCells` now holds its noise data in an indexed vector stored in `CaloCellConstantsSvc` instead of a per-tool map. This is faster, uses less memory and avoids duplicating the data when the tool is configured several times. The author verified that ALLEGRO reconstruction results are unchanged.
